sentences: The non-returning compare-and-store: `M = (M == data0) ? data1 : M`, the same `OpAtomicCompareExchange` as `ds_cmpst_rtn_b32` with the old value dropped (operands vaddr, data0, data1).

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_lds_atomics_values.py`; GPU-checked by `runtime/test/shaders/cs_lds_b64_cmpst.asm` (hit and miss on an RTX 3070, driver 621.01, Windows 11), and measured on native gfx1100 through `tools/hw_oracle` (hit, miss and hit-to-zero), where GFX11 spells it `ds_cmpstore_b32` with the store value before the compare value.
